title: Connect Tinglan to Codex App Server
summary: Create a localhost bridge that owns Codex App Server stdio, ChatGPT-managed login, streamed turns, thread persistence, approvals, and safe transcript-to-notes prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser never receives or stores ChatGPT OAuth tokens or API keys.
The user can complete ChatGPT-managed Codex login and see account/rate-limit state.
The default notes model is gpt-5.6-luna with low reasoning and streamed output.
A transcript produces structured summary, assignments, deadlines, exam points, and timestamped citations.
Free-form questions return answers grounded only in the selected course recordings.
Offline, unauthenticated, quota-limited, cancelled, and server-restart states are recoverable and truthful.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
